d: Patna Encounter Updates: bihar men NDA sarkar ki salgirah se pahle bahut bara enkauntar huaa hai...patna se sate maner men tin apradhi jepi yadav, bablu kumar aur raja sharma ko pulis ne muthbher men mar giraya hai...enkauntar men maner thanadhyaksh ke hath men goli lag gaee...vahin enkauntar ke bad danapur anumandal aspatal men pulis aur mritkon ke parijnon ke bich ek shakhs ke mukhibiri ko lekar jharap ki sthiti ban gaee...dusri or aspatal pahunchin misa bharti ne pure mamle ki nyayik janch ki mang ki hain...riport dekhie...
